cards.name: Eridani, Squire of Zephorion Prime

effects.printed_clause: If "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" is in your field or GY (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon this card from your hand.
effects.lua_implementation: A hand Quick Effect checks a face-up exact code on field or exact code in GY, then Special Summons the related handler.

official_references.official_effect_text:
If this card is Special Summoned by the effect of "Parallel eXceed", its Level becomes 4 [b]and[/b] its original ATK/DEF become halved. [b]You can[/b] only use each of the following effects of "Parallel eXceed" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
● If you Link Summon: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon this card from your hand to your zone that Link Monster points to.
● If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: [b]You can[/b] Special Summon 1 "Parallel eXceed" from your Deck.

effects.printed_clause: If "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" is in your GY, your opponent cannot declare an attack.
effects.lua_implementation: A field EFFECT_CANNOT_ATTACK_ANNOUNCE targets the opponent Monster Zone while an exact code remains in the controller GY.

official_references.official_effect_text: Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up Attack Position monster on the field; that face-up monster [b]cannot[/b] be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects, your opponent [b]cannot[/b] [b]target[/b] it with card effects, [b]also[/b] it [b]cannot[/b] attack your opponent directly. [b]When[/b] this card leaves the field, [b]destroy[/b] that monster. [b]When[/b] that monster leaves the field, [b]destroy[/b] this card.

effects.printed_clause: If this card is destroyed by "Eldora, the Intergalactic Empire" or your opponent's card effect: You can declare 1 Monster Card name; cards with that name cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects until the end of this turn.
effects.lua_implementation: A delayed REASON_EFFECT trigger announces a TYPE_MONSTER code, then registers battle/effect indestructibility for matching codes in both players’ hand/field/GY/banishment through PHASE_END.

official_references.matched_structure: announce and store Monster Card code
official_references.official_effect_text: Declare 1 Monster Card name; this turn, neither player can Special Summon monsters with that original name, except from the GY. [b]You can[/b] [b]banish[/b] this card from the GY, [b]then[/b] declare 1 Monster Card name; this turn, neither player can activate the effects of monsters on the field with that original name. [b]You can[/b] only use 1 "The Black Goat Laughs" effect [b]per turn[/b], [b]and[/b] only [b]once[/b] that turn.

Activate this card by targeting 1 face-up Attack Position monster on the field; that face-up monster [b]cannot[/b] be destroyed by battle or your opponent's card effects, your opponent [b]cannot[/b] [b]target[/b] it with card effects, [b]also[/b] it [b]cannot[/b] attack your opponent directly. [b]When[/b] this card leaves the field, [b]destroy[/b] that monster. [b]When[/b] that monster leaves the field, [b]destroy[/b] this card.

effects.printed_clause: You can only use each effect of "Eridani, Squire of Zephorion Prime" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: Activated Summon/destruction effects use separate id/id+100 hard limits; the continuous attack lock does not activate.

official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent controls 2 or more monsters, [b]you can[/b] Special Summon this card (from your hand). [b]You can[/b] only Special Summon "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b] this way. If this card is Normal or Special Summoned [b]and[/b] your opponent controls a monster: [b]You can[/b] [b]target[/b] 1 Level 4 LIGHT monster in your GY, except "Moon Gardna"; add it to your hand. [b]You can[/b] only use this effect of "Moon Gardna" [b]once[/b] [b]per turn[/b].
